xmltest.pas::DoSample.text: Test mode "sample": reads a few known values from a .dsn file with the reader and prints them.

DoUU.text: Test mode "uu": UU-encodes each line of hex from the file (45-byte lines), decodes it again and checks it matches.

params.FileName: file with one hex string per line

xmltest.pas::DoRoundTrip.text: Test mode "roundtrip": writes a document with the writer, reads it back and checks the values.

DoSymbols.text: Test mode "symbols": loads every named symbol of a library as a design symbol and places them all in one design, which it saves.

DoRestore.text: Test mode "restore": stores every set of a library back onto itself (an update), to test the write path in place.

designtest.pas::DoGeom.text: Test mode "geom": updates layout, then probes the geometry of every object (including the objects inside symbols) and prints the totals.

DoStats.text: Test mode "stats": prints the number of sheets, objects and resources in a design.
